translation: And yangming and taiyang pass the ear gate and come out above the ear; at first wind ringing accumulates, and if severe, deafness. When I was thirty-one, a sore grew in my left ear, commonly called the ear bottom (耳底). The pain and oppression were unbearable, to the extreme; all night I covered my ear and walked around the courtyard, and with a clang it rang once, the qi came out and it healed; this was the beginning of my deafness.
